correctness.rationale: The defining pair-sum condition is checked directly on every candidate. All 12,870 size-eight subsets fail and all 11,440 size-seven subsets are exhaustively tested, giving 240 maxima; heredity excludes larger sets. All 384 Hamming isometries are generated explicitly, the two orbits exhaust the 240 maxima, stabilizers satisfy orbit–stabilizer, and the stated distance profiles are checked on every orbit member. The computation uses exact integers only.

value.rationale: This is a complete equality classification for a canonical small B2/Sidon-code benchmark, not merely a recomputation of the known optimum. It shows that the standard published maximum witness belongs to only one of two natural extremal geometries, gives the exact literal count and stabilizers, and supplies a simple distance-profile invariant distinguishing the two types. These data are useful for testing constructions, normalization assumptions, and conjectured uniqueness patterns in small separable/B2 codes.
